note: Family park 2 mi north of I-70 Exit 52 near Mulberry Grove, mostly seasonal campers, with a row of long pull-throughs facing a cornfield for overnight stays; pool, three stocked fishing ponds and a small lake. The operator's site posts no rate; RV Life reviewers paid $35-40 a night, cash, in July-October 2026. --Claude
summary: Operator site (old itgo page, no rates), Google 4.5/86, RV Life $$ with five 2026 reviews ($35-40 cash), imagery. Mostly seasonal: ~150-180 set-up seasonal pads vs a ~10-12 pad transient pull-through row (~6-8%). No posted nightly rate and no booking channel, so long-stay test 2 fails: DROP CANDIDATE. Pin is the highway entrance, ~540 m south of the park.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (mostly seasonal + no posted nightly rate): the operator's only web page posts no price, no season and no booking link; an RV Life tier does not satisfy long-stay test 2 (a nightly rate on its own site + phone, or a booking site). RV Life reviewer 8/2026: 'Mostly seasonal campers but we really needed a relaxing overnight stop.' Imagery: roughly 150-180 pads with decks/roofs/sheds against ~10-12 empty pull-through pads on the south row facing the cornfield, about 6-8% transient, under the 1-in-10 line of test 4 (no operator count exists, so this is an estimate). Reviews are good (Google 4.5/86; RV Life 5 reviews 8-10/10) and campers paid $35-40, which is why it is a candidate rather than clear-cut. Not stayed at by the family (no trip references).
PIN: stored 38.92206,-89.28826 is the IL-140 entrance lane, ~540 m south of the campground. If kept, move to 38.9268,-89.2895 (park centre between the ponds).

PRICE: none stored. Camper-reported $35-40 a night (RV Life, July-October 2026, cash) put in the note only; the operator has a page, so the report cannot price the entry. Under the $50 gate either way. No gateway within 40 km.
